مَيْعَةٌ
Briskness, liveliness, or sprightliness. (S.) The prime, or first part, of youth, and of the day. (S, K.) The first part of the run of a horse: (S:) the first part, and the briskness, liveliness, or sprightliness, of a run, and of intoxication: or the main part of anything. (TA.) ―
-b2- And The flowing of anything poured out. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
